posts.text: It's been a month since I finished my summer internship at TD, and I already miss everyone! 💚 This summer, I had the chance to work on the ML Standardization team, where I learned a lot about building and supporting production ML systems. I worked on internal tools for a RAG-based AI monitoring platform, a schema migration framework, and improvements to our model deployment library. I'm very grateful for the people I got to work with this summer. Thank you to my manager Robbie and my teammates G

🌟One of the best parts of being a TD intern is the opportunity to attend amazing workshops led by amazing mentors. This week, to attend a session from the 'Connect & Learn' series on 'Consumer Trends & Navigating your Career with TD'. Jeff Chan, Senior Manager at TD Invent, shared incredibly thoughtful insights on emerging technology trends and how they influence consumer behavior. His presentation really resonated with me as it challenged us to think critically about how we approach our project

🌟Exciting News🌟 I am happy to share that I am a new Campus Influencer during my summer with TD representing Western University! Watch this space as I bring you more insights on my experience at TD, career growth tips, and all things TD Campus related! #TDCampus #TD

I'm thrilled to share that I will be joining TD as a Software Engineer Intern in summer 2025! A huge thank you to Fariz Shakil for the amazing recruitment process and another big thank you to Md Shujon Alam for the insightful interview! I truly appreciate everyone who supported me along the way—this wouldn't have been possible without you! Looking forward to this incredible opportunity to learn, grow, and contribute at TD! 🚀
It was such an amazing experience! Lots of learning and fun! Thank you my team for working with me and thank you HackWestern for organizing!

At the start of 2024, I attended two amazing hackathons! Here are some brief things about what my teams and I achieved! I attended the beginner stream of SheHacks8+, Hacker Olympics, hosted by WITS at Western University. This was my first ever hackathon and my team, Hacktresses, honorably won 3rd place out of 12+ teams in this stream. We created a jungle information website called, Madagascar Information Website.
